t_row_all: Show the log of every app
t_empty: Join your fortress with its phrase, and every app in it shows up here.
t_engine: The TollRoll service does not answer. Reinstalling the plugin starts it again.
s_sub: One dashboard tile for your apps: how each one is doing, and one log for all of them.
s_tile_hint: The tile appears on the dashboard by itself. Hide, move or collapse it with Unraid's own tile controls. Click an app or a button above the log to see only that app's lines. The log stays dark on every theme, like a terminal.
e_engine: the TollRoll service does not answer
s_notify_hint: While a channel is on, TollRoll checks your apps once a minute. It tells you when an app stops answering, when it answers again and when it shows something new that needs you. Each of these is sent once.
s_n_apprise_hint: The address of a key on your Apprise API server, such as http://192.168.1.10:8000/notify/tollroll.
s_n_err_invalid: a field is missing or not valid
n_down_body: TollRoll could not read {name} for a few minutes. The TollRoll settings show why.
n_test_body: If you read this, TollRoll can reach you here.
